### Ops Manager Profiler

- **Ops Manager Profiler** · self — Ops Manager Profiler tails mongod slow-query logs; it does not write system.profile. Its project collection switch does not enable or disable the database profiler. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ops-manager/current/tutorial/profile-database.md
